title: Automation (Workflows)
subtitle: One trigger + ordered steps, executed through the same real agents, tools, and approvals — no new engine.
noneHint: Create a new Workflow or ask Frost to create one.
activateConfirm: This Workflow will become active and can actually run.
runNowConfirm: This will start a real run of this Workflow immediately.
archiveConfirm: This Workflow will no longer appear in active lists.
cancelRunConfirm: The current step may still complete before stopping. No new step will start after that.

design.heading: Put recurring work on a clear path.
design.intro: Turn repeat tasks into organized workflows. Connect events to agents and keep approvals in your team’s hands.
design.guideNote: You define the path. Your team stays in control.
design.libraryHint: Organize your workflows and track their status in one place.
design.activeTitle: Build a flow. Skip the repetition.
design.activeHint: Create a draft, add its steps, then activate it when ready. Or ask Frost to help you plan.
design.draftHint: Save your steps as a draft and review them before activating.
design.pausedHint: Workflows you pause will appear here, ready to resume later.
design.archivedHint: Workflows you finish and archive will appear here for reference.
design.healthyTitle: No failures in the reviewed runs
design.healthyHint: This view checks the latest 50 runs of each non-archived workflow so you can investigate failures and take action.
